Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 30,000eb - 6 Months
Slots: 10

Iconic Cyberdeck with 8 slots for Programs and 2 for Hardware, usable only while installed in a Neuroport Cyberdeck Port. Once in, it stays in: taking it out inside a month costs 5,000eb and a week in a hospital. While using it the user gets one more NET Action each turn, and may take as many further NET Actions as they like beyond their limit, at 2 Humanity Loss each. Installed, it opens the Blackwall Gateway Quickhack. Users also hear things from past the Blackwall now and then; roleplay accordingly. BLACKWALL GATEWAY (DV varies): on activation, choose whether it spreads to up to 2 more targets within 20m/yds of the first. It lands on the original, then the second the following Round, then the third the Round after. DV starts at 10 and rises 2 per extra target, to a maximum of 14, and one roll covers all three. Unlike every other Quickhack it can be attempted however many Passwalls the Netrunner has breached. Every attempt, hit or miss, costs the user 1d6 Humanity and 1d6 HP. On a hit the target's mind fills with horrors that tear at their nervous system: 6d6 straight to HP with no ablation, 1d6 Humanity Loss, MOVE down by 1d6 for 9 seconds (3 Rounds), and the Short Circuit Quickhack's effect; double 6s on the damage also inflict the Brain Injury Critical Injury, though not its bonus damage. A Seriously Wounded target takes 2d6 more (8d6), loses another 1d6 MOVE (2d6 total) and falls Prone. A Mortally Wounded one rolls a Death Save at once as though their Death Save Penalty were 10 higher.

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.
  • The sheet keeps one slot count, so this carries all 10; it won't hold Programs and Hardware to their own 8 and 2.
  • Blackwall Gateway is described here rather than built as a separate program item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Gear).
